skill_domain: skill engineering, meta-skill, self-evolving AI systems

findings.title: Anthropic Claude Code Skill System (Internal)
findings.source: context: CLAUDE.md and meta_whitepaper.md design principles
findings.key_finding: Skill files are YAML-frontmatter markdown files loaded as slash commands; federation protocol 1.0 governs skill registration and version management; only-increase eval principle prevents gaming
findings.design_impact: manifest.yaml federation_protocol 字段；SKILL.md frontmatter 只允许 name 和 description 两字段

findings.title: BenchBench: Meta-Benchmarking for LLM Evaluation Benchmarks
findings.key_finding: Benchmark quality varies widely; evaluation benchmarks themselves need quality metrics; contamination and saturation are systemic risks in static benchmarks
findings.design_impact: only-increase + judge_calibration 的设计动机：防止 eval suite 退化为 benchmark contamination

findings.title: Promptimize: Systematic Prompt Evaluation and Optimization
findings.key_finding: Prompt quality can be systematically measured via structured test cases; regression testing prevents prompt improvements from breaking existing functionality
findings.design_impact: validate.sh 的 --ship 模式 + only-increase 原则：防止 prompt 改进导致功能回归

top_insights: 竞品系统（PromptFoo、Evals）关注单次评估，缺少 self-evolution 的完整闭环
only-increase 约束 + P2 归档是 awesome-skill-creator 独有的约束管理机制
judge_calibration 在竞品工具中没有对应实现，是明确的差异化能力

suggested_eval_cases.description: validate_evals.sh 检测到缺少 judge_calibration 断言时报 FAIL
